comment: Golden round-trip vector for the 2-of-3 threshold-HPKE KEM. Pins the deterministic ceremony seed + plaintext + expected ciphertext shape + decap-share contract. The runtime impl must produce a working roundtrip when fed these inputs. Filed under flywheel_connectors-angoc.11.6.

expected_ciphertext_shape.note: Encapsulated key is the X25519 ephemeral public key (32 bytes). AEAD body length is plaintext_len + tag_len (16). Note: this fixture does not pin EXACT ciphertext bytes because the implementation choice of ephemeral randomness MAY vary; the implementation MUST verify the roundtrip property instead.

expected_decap_shares.comment: When 2 of 3 participants compute decap shares, the combine function MUST yield the original plaintext. Order independence MUST hold.

roundtrip_property.description: For each 2-element subset S of {1, 2, 3}, combine_decap(encap_output, S) returns the original plaintext bytes.

byzantine_tolerance.comment: If any participant submits an inconsistent share (e.g., decap-share for a different ciphertext), combine_decap MUST return ThresholdHpkeError::InconsistentShares rather than a wrong plaintext.

inconsistent_share_subsets.bad_share_description: Decap share computed from a different ciphertext (different epoch)

hybrid_mode_placeholder.note: When the Phase N PQ track exposes a stable ML-KEM-768 share-derivation API, the hybrid mode fixture (concatenated classical+PQ encapsulation, both decap or fail) gets added as 2of3_hybrid_roundtrip.json.
